<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def placed():
    out={}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','p','R','b','N','Y','M') and 10<=n['pixels']<=20:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(x[0] for x in b); c0=min(x[1] for x in b)
            if r0>10: out[(r0,c0)]=n['color']
    return out
st=placed()
print(st)
ok = st.get((22,22))=='R' and st.get((22,28))=='b' and st.get((22,40))=='Y' and st.get((36,22))=='O' and st.get((36,28))=='p' and st.get((36,34))=='N' and st.get((36,40))=='M'
print("arrangement ok:", ok)
if ok:
    action(['SPACE'])
    print("space:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','reward','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
